_comment: T-381, the tutorial slides' and the pause screen's trick list's text (HUD and menus, Content, 'Tutorial slides and trick list'); the UI tickets read it, no text in code. Every line scored 8 or more in the style loop (T-381's Style review). Keys: slide1.*, slide2.*, slide3.*, trick.<id> (reused word for word from the trick popups and recap_text.json), button.*, checkbox.*, arrow.*. Each entry has a '<key>_comment' line saying where it appears.

slide1.controls: W accelerate, S brake/reverse, A left, D right. Live viewers want confidence. Fake it.
slide1.controls_comment: Slide 1 (the controls), first line: what W, A, S and D do.
slide1.drift: Accelerate while turning and the car drifts on its own. No drift button, zero friction.
slide1.drift_comment: Slide 1 (the controls), second line under the controls: accelerating while turning drifts the car.

slide2.chain: Tricks bring live viewers. Live viewers bring subs.
slide2.chain_comment: Slide 2 (the loop), first line under the trick list: tricks bring viewers, viewers bring subs.
slide2.gift: Every sub goal brings a gift pack: a weapon that keeps enemies away and the stream alive.
slide2.gift_comment: Slide 2 (the loop), second line under the trick list: a sub goal brings a gift pack with a weapon that helps survive and keeps enemies away.

slide3.goal: Chain tricks for gift packs. Be maxed out for the kaiju at 1 minute left. Peak content.
slide3.goal_comment: Slide 3 (the goal): chain tricks to get the most weapons and be strongest when the kaiju arrives with 1 minute left.

trick.comment: Slide 2 (the loop) and the pause screen's trick list panel: the name beside each trick's illustration, one per trick id in game/docs/driving/tricks.md. Reused word for word from the trick popups (recap_text.json trick.*), so each trick has one name.

button.start_comment: Slide 3's button that starts the run (the board's word is 'Start'; the style loop's pick 'Go live' scored 9, a proposal for the playtest).
button.trick_list_comment: The pause screen's button that opens the trick list panel.
button.back_comment: The trick list panel's back control, returning to the pause screen.

checkbox.dont_show_comment: Slide 3, the checkbox label beside the Start button: ticked, the slides don't appear on later Starts.

arrow.left_comment: The left arrow's accessible label (tooltip) on the tutorial slides.
arrow.right_comment: The right arrow's accessible label (tooltip) on the tutorial slides.
